Adobe treats this as a separate reporting dimension. Leaving it empty is allowed. Filling it inconsistently is not, because the same product then appears under two categories.
This is the product identity for the life of the report suite. Send the SKU the business uses, never the display name, and never a name that changes when marketing rewrites it.
Quantity is what is being added or bought in this event, not what is in the cart. Sending the cart total on every add is the most common way a Units figure ends up three times too high.
Total price for the line, meaning unit price multiplied by quantity, before discount. Not the unit price when quantity is more than one.
Numeric and currency events bound to this product. Separated by a pipe when there is more than one. This is the only way a discount can be reported per product.
Bound to the product, so they survive to the order. Set as product syntax merchandising in the report suite, never as a plain eVar, or the binding never happens.
